p9/esc539:10.speaker: supporter
p9/esc539:10.text: I'm sorry, I'm sure that has made you feel rejected.

p9/esc539:12.speaker: supporter
p9/esc539:12.text: I'm sure it is hard to express how you feel with it being a short relationship, people may not understand. But sometimes we can feel such a strong connection and have faith in people very fast.

p9/esc539:14.speaker: seeker
p9/esc539:14.text: i loved the girl with all my heart

p9/esc539:15.speaker: supporter
p9/esc539:15.text: I understand feeling connected to someone you've only known for a short amount of time. I'm sure you feel like you wont be able to let your guard down again anytime soon.

p9/esc539:16.speaker: seeker
p9/esc539:16.text: yes i have faith in people very fast

p9/esc539:17.speaker: seeker
p9/esc539:17.text: seriously its like your seeing my mind

p9/esc539:18.speaker: supporter
p9/esc539:18.text: Maybe this could be a learning experience? I always try to see the best in people, but have learned to let people earn my trust. Not just get it for free.

p9/esc539:3.speaker: supporter
p9/esc539:3.text: I'm doing well. How can I help you today?

p9/esc539:4.speaker: seeker
p9/esc539:4.text: a break up with my partner please read up

p9/esc539:5.speaker: supporter
p9/esc539:5.text: I'm so sorry. I went through a bad break up last year. Can you tell me what happened?

p9/esc539:8.speaker: seeker
p9/esc539:8.text: i and this lady dated for 2weeks

p9/esc539:9.speaker: seeker
p9/esc539:9.text: suddenly she said she doesn't love me anymore imagine that

p9/esc682:0.speaker: seeker
p9/esc682:0.text: I just lost my job and am worried about paying the bills.

p9/esc682:1.speaker: supporter
p9/esc682:1.text: I'm sorry to hear you lost your job and have worries about paying the bills.

p9/esc682:11.speaker: supporter
p9/esc682:11.text: Also, job counselors may help at employment agencies to match you with potential employers. Have you tried any?

p9/esc682:12.speaker: seeker
p9/esc682:12.text: I haven't but that may be helpful as well.

p9/esc682:13.speaker: supporter
p9/esc682:13.text: I sought out help from a recruiter online who helped me to find a job as well.  Have you heard of that option or tried it?

p9/esc682:14.speaker: seeker
p9/esc682:14.text: That might help me to take the stress off myself and get someone to help in the search.

p9/esc682:15.speaker: supporter
p9/esc682:15.text: Yes, I see that you seemed to be more relieved finding out these options. Would you say these suggestions have been helpful?

p9/esc682:16.speaker: seeker
p9/esc682:16.text: Yes, I'm starting to feel some of the pressure taken off me.

p9/esc682:17.speaker: supporter
p9/esc682:17.text: From what I've seen, people who can use some of these strategies like deep breathing and counseling they have felt some relief and could move forward better toward their goals.

p9/esc682:18.speaker: seeker
p9/esc682:18.text: I feel a lot better.  Thanks for your support.

p9/esc682:19.speaker: supporter
p9/esc682:19.text: You are welcome.  Can I help you with anything else?

p9/esc682:2.speaker: seeker
p9/esc682:2.text: There is just too much pressure, but I have to succeed.

p9/esc682:20.speaker: seeker
p9/esc682:20.text: I think that will be all.  Thanks again.

p9/esc682:3.speaker: supporter
p9/esc682:3.text: That is hard having so much pressure but I think you will be able to soon get employed again.

p9/esc682:4.speaker: seeker
p9/esc682:4.text: I am trying.  I've started looking online for new positions but it is a process.

p9/esc682:5.speaker: supporter
p9/esc682:5.text: It sounds like you are trying really hard and that is worthy of praise.

p9/esc682:6.speaker: seeker
p9/esc682:6.text: I just still am continually nervous and having a hard time coping.

p9/esc682:7.speaker: supporter
p9/esc682:7.text: Sometimes deep breaths help people calm down.  Have you tried that at all?

p9/esc682:8.speaker: seeker
p9/esc682:8.text: I haven't but maybe that will help me stay calmer.

p9/esc682:9.speaker: supporter
p9/esc682:9.text: That can sometimes help you to regain your focus and be able to do more for yourself.

p9/esc82:10.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:10.text: I am really sorry that has got to be the worst feeling putting your dog to sleep

p9/esc82:11.speaker: seeker
p9/esc82:11.text: It is. At least I was able to be with her so she wasn't afraid.

p9/esc82:12.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:12.text: I just think of it this way your dog is in dog heaven and is watching over you that is how i think of it even though it really aint true thats just how i think

p9/esc82:13.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:13.text: My dog died of old age

p9/esc82:14.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:14.text: it took me like 2 or 3 weeks to get over it and not cry for once

p9/esc82:15.speaker: seeker
p9/esc82:15.text: I just miss her. I believe she is with her brother. He died 7 years ago. He was hit by a car.

p9/esc82:17.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:17.text: I can understand how you feeling but everything will be okay and it is ok to miss her

p9/esc82:18.speaker: seeker
p9/esc82:18.text: I was doing pretty good then there was this dog in the movie and I just broke down again.

p9/esc82:19.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:19.text: I understand I would break down to if I saw that

p9/esc82:2.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:2.text: How may i help you today?

p9/esc82:20.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:20.text: Just do something you like to do to get your mind off of it

p9/esc82:21.speaker: seeker
p9/esc82:21.text: It helps to have a person to talk to. I used this chat Hit before right after I had to put her to sleep. The person I talked to then had a dog too.

p9/esc82:22.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:22.text: Right it is always good to have someone to talk to in a situation like that

p9/esc82:23.speaker: seeker
p9/esc82:23.text: It's a good Idea to do something to get my mind off of it.

p9/esc82:24.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:24.text: Just by expressing your feelings with someone will help a lot to

p9/esc82:26.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:26.text: Maybe you can watch a comedy movie or another kind of movie to get your mind off of it

p9/esc82:27.speaker: seeker
p9/esc82:27.text: That sounds like a good idea. A comedy probably would help

p9/esc82:28.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:28.text: yes it would help. Keep your head up and know your dog is dog heaven and not suffering anymore.

p9/esc82:3.speaker: seeker
p9/esc82:3.text: I've been sad. My dog died

p9/esc82:4.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:4.text: I am sorry I know exactly how you are feeling I have had a dog that i loved more than anything die couple years ago

p9/esc82:5.speaker: seeker
p9/esc82:5.text: Sorry to hear that. I just watched a movie that had a dog that looked like mine in it. It upset me

p9/esc82:7.speaker: seeker
p9/esc82:7.text: I don't remember the name of the movie, but it was about some kids trying to find homes for dogs that a shelter was closing before Christmas

p9/esc82:8.speaker: supporter
p9/esc82:8.text: Oh ok how did your dog die was something wrong with him or just old age?

p9/esc82:9.speaker: seeker
p9/esc82:9.text: She was old, blind and was getting dog dementia. I had to have her put to sleep

p9/esc88:1.speaker: seeker
p9/esc88:1.text: Not great. I'm feeling pretty down in the dumps.

p9/esc88:10.speaker: seeker
p9/esc88:10.text: Fair enough. What do you suggest I try?

p9/esc88:11.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:11.text: I am going to ask you a few questions if OK i don't want to sound like i am prying.

p9/esc88:12.speaker: seeker
p9/esc88:12.text: That's fine. I'm open to discussion.

p9/esc88:13.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:13.text: OK do yo live in a rural or city, are you into male females or the like?

p9/esc88:14.speaker: seeker
p9/esc88:14.text: I'm in a rural area, and I'm interested in women.

p9/esc88:15.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:15.text: I too live in a rural area understand the complexities of tying to find someone. So my next question where looking to find that special connection.

p9/esc88:16.speaker: seeker
p9/esc88:16.text: I've had to resort to online dating and such as there are few opportunities to meet people in person.

p9/esc88:17.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:17.text: I understand doing that I have tried it myself and trying to find that connection is few and far between. What sites have you tried using?

p9/esc88:18.speaker: seeker
p9/esc88:18.text: Basically all of the ones you would expect. How would you suggest meeting people in person?

p9/esc88:19.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:19.text: Well It would depend on if you were religious I  would suggest church functions for example. I use my hobbies like pool and darts and cards and join groups that creates some common ground.

p9/esc88:2.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:2.text: Im sorry to hear that. how can I help

p9/esc88:20.speaker: seeker
p9/esc88:20.text: That sounds like a good idea. Do you attend meetups?

p9/esc88:21.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:21.text: I have and i usually take someone i  trust with me and if it doesnt feel right I leave.

p9/esc88:22.speaker: seeker
p9/esc88:22.text: That's good advice. Thanks for your help.

p9/esc88:23.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:23.text: No problem glad I could help.

p9/esc88:24.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:24.text: Is there anything else I can help with?

p9/esc88:3.speaker: seeker
p9/esc88:3.text: I'm not sure how, exactly. I'm dealing with repeated rejections.

p9/esc88:4.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:4.text: That is always tough especially during this time of year and been there myself.

p9/esc88:5.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:5.text: What type of rejection  are you experiencing

p9/esc88:6.speaker: seeker
p9/esc88:6.text: Romantic rejection. It seems like every time I make an effort, it's immediately shot down.

p9/esc88:7.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:7.text: I hate to ask you this but are you male or female?

p9/esc88:9.speaker: supporter
p9/esc88:9.text: I ask it changes the perception on how I may help you because male and females deal with things differently.

p9/esc994:0.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:0.text: Hi, I'm here to listen. What's going on?

p9/esc994:1.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:1.text: Thank you. I've lost my job and I'm very nervous about the future

p9/esc994:10.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:10.text: I am a gig worker, so I cannot apply for IU. Its very hard, but i also have some savings.

p9/esc994:11.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:11.text: What kind of tools would you recommend I use to get through this

p9/esc994:12.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:12.text: Well, falling back on savings while you look for more work is good for a while. If you have any food insecurity as a result, there are often local food banks. It's really not something to be embarrased about, so many people face food insecurity through no fault of their own.

p9/esc994:13.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:13.text: You could also give a call to your local social services because they will be able to tell you what resources would be available, whether it's a vocational program or temporary assistance.

p9/esc994:14.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:14.text: Wow you're so helpful and encouraging! It's very nice to talk to you.

p9/esc994:15.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:15.text: Are there any meds you can recommend to help me sleep?

p9/esc994:16.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:16.text: Well, if it's possible, I would talk to a doctor. If you're looking for Over-the-counter sleep medication, melatonin has helped me in the past.

p9/esc994:17.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:17.text: Wow! I've never used melatonin before. Did it really help you? Are you doing much better now?

p9/esc994:18.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:18.text: It defiitely helps me fall asleep.

p9/esc994:2.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:2.text: As a result I am having a hard time sleeping

p9/esc994:20.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:20.text: If something like that doesn't work, I would talk to a doctor. I know money will be tight though. Are there any free clinics near you?

p9/esc994:21.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:21.text: I'll look into it. There's a lot of services in the general area that might be able to help me

p9/esc994:22.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:22.text: It's been really nice talking to you

p9/esc994:23.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:23.text: Thank you. I hope you're feeling a bit better. Is there anything else you want to talk about?

p9/esc994:24.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:24.text: No I'm okay. I think that's everything :)

p9/esc994:25.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:25.text: Alright, well I hope you have a good night. Good luck, you've got this!

p9/esc994:3.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:3.text: Wow, that's very hard. I would be anxious too.

p9/esc994:4.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:4.text: That makes me feel a lot better. Have you ever lost your job?

p9/esc994:5.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:5.text: I have. I was laid off. It was nerve-racking, but also really sad.

p9/esc994:6.speaker: seeker
p9/esc994:6.text: What helped you get through it?

p9/esc994:7.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:7.text: I had a bit in savings, but I looked for new jobs mostly. I was on unemployment insurance for about a month before I found a new job.

p9/esc994:8.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:8.text: Have you made any plans yet about how to move forward?

p9/esc994:9.speaker: supporter
p9/esc994:9.text: I can offer some suggestions if you would like. I know about a lot of resources

p9/p9_conv_1:0.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_1:0.text: Hey Michael, how’s everything going with you today?

p9/p9_conv_1:1.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_1:1.text: Hey, to be honest, I've been better. Feeling a bit stuck right now.

p9/p9_conv_1:10.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_1:10.text: Your concerns are completely valid. Financial stability and having support around is really important. Have you considered any alternatives?

p9/p9_conv_1:11.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_1:11.text: I've been looking for more opportunities around here, but they are few and far between. It’s making me feel pretty trapped.

p9/p9_conv_1:12.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_1:12.text: It must be frustrating to feel like your options are limited. How do you usually handle situations like this?

p9/p9_conv_1:13.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_1:13.text: I usually just try to work through it, hoping something better comes up. But it’s hard to stay positive right now.

p9/p9_conv_1:14.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_1:14.text: It's understandable to feel overwhelmed. Sometimes, exploring small steps towards what you want can help. Is there anything that brings you a bit of hope?

p9/p9_conv_1:15.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_1:15.text: I guess the occasional freelance gig that pays better and lets me stay around here. It’s just uncertain when those come up.

p9/p9_conv_1:16.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_1:16.text: Stability in those gigs can be a silver lining. Maybe balancing them until something more stable appears is a way forward?

p9/p9_conv_1:17.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_1:17.text: Yeah, I think I should focus on that for now. Thanks for listening and helping me clarify things a bit.

p9/p9_conv_1:18.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_1:18.text: Anytime, Michael. It's important to weigh all your options and take care of yourself, too. I'm here whenever you need to talk.

p9/p9_conv_1:19.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_1:19.text: I appreciate that a lot. I guess I just needed to get it off my chest.

p9/p9_conv_1:2.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_1:2.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you want to talk about what's been on your mind?

p9/p9_conv_1:20.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_1:20.text: I'm really glad you did. Remember, you're not alone in this. We'll figure it out together.

p9/p9_conv_1:3.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_1:3.text: I got a job offer. Normally, that would be good news, but it's not as great as it sounds.

p9/p9_conv_1:4.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_1:4.text: Oh really? What's got you feeling hesitant about it?

p9/p9_conv_1:5.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_1:5.text: Well, it’s far from where I live, in a completely different area, and the pay is pretty low.

p9/p9_conv_1:6.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_1:6.text: That sounds really challenging. Moving and taking a pay cut are big decisions. What are your main concerns?

p9/p9_conv_1:7.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_1:7.text: Mainly, it's about leaving behind what little network I have here and starting over somewhere else for something that doesn’t seem worth it.

p9/p9_conv_1:8.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_1:8.text: Leaving familiar places and people can be really tough. It makes sense that you'd feel conflicted.

p9/p9_conv_1:9.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_1:9.text: Exactly. I keep thinking, is it worth uprooting everything just for the sake of a job that might not even cover my basic expenses?

p9/p9_conv_2:0.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_2:0.text: Hi Michael, how have you been lately?

p9/p9_conv_2:1.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_2:1.text: Hey. It's been a bit tough. I accepted that job far from home, but now I just feel so isolated.

p9/p9_conv_2:10.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_2:10.text: It can be bittersweet to stay connected when you're far away. Maybe finding small ways to bring parts of 'home' into your new space could help?

p9/p9_conv_2:11.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_2:11.text: Like what? I brought a few things, but it doesn't feel the same.

p9/p9_conv_2:12.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_2:12.text: How about recreating a favorite routine or cooking some of your favorite meals? Little things like that might bring a sense of familiarity.

p9/p9_conv_2:13.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_2:13.text: That's a good idea. I do miss my mom's cooking. Maybe I can start with her recipes.

p9/p9_conv_2:14.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_2:14.text: That sounds like a wonderful way to feel connected. Experimenting in the kitchen might even become a fun activity for you after work.

p9/p9_conv_2:15.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_2:15.text: I'll try it this weekend. I guess I'm just worried that I won't ever feel 'at home' here.

p9/p9_conv_2:16.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_2:16.text: That's a valid concern, Michael. Feeling at home takes time and can be different for everyone. Allow yourself the space to adjust and remember that it's okay to reach out for support whenever you need it.

p9/p9_conv_2:17.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_2:17.text: Thanks. I appreciate talking about this. I don't feel as overwhelmed knowing there's someone here to listen.

p9/p9_conv_2:18.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_2:18.text: I'm always here for you. You're doing the best you can, and that counts for a lot. You're not alone in this, remember that.

p9/p9_conv_2:2.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_2:2.text: I'm really sorry to hear that. Feeling isolated can be really challenging. What's been the hardest part for you?

p9/p9_conv_2:3.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_2:3.text: I think it's just being away from everything I know. I wake up, go to work, and come back to an empty place. It's like I'm moving in a loop with no way out.

p9/p9_conv_2:4.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_2:4.text: That sounds incredibly difficult, Michael. It's natural to feel this way when everything around you is new and unfamiliar. Have you considered exploring the new area a bit more?

p9/p9_conv_2:5.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_2:5.text: I have, but it's hard to muster the energy after work. Plus, I can't stop thinking if this was the right choice.

p9/p9_conv_2:6.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_2:6.text: Second-guessing a big decision is totally normal, especially when the stakes are high. Remember, you took this step to support yourself by taking this job despite its challenges.

p9/p9_conv_2:7.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_2:7.text: I know, but some days I feel like I let myself down by moving here. I miss everyone back home, and the pay isn't even that great.

p9/p9_conv_2:8.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_2:8.text: It's okay to miss your home and familiar surroundings. You're already showing a lot of courage by facing this situation head-on. Have you had any contact with your friends or family since you moved?

p9/p9_conv_2:9.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_2:9.text: Yeah, I call them sometimes. It's good to hear their voices, but it just makes me more homesick sometimes.

p9/p9_conv_3:0.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_3:0.text: Hey, I don't know if I should even be reaching out...

p9/p9_conv_3:1.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_3:1.text: Hi Michael, I'm here for you. What's been going on?

p9/p9_conv_3:10.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_3:10.text: I used to go hiking around my town a lot. It helped clear my mind.

p9/p9_conv_3:11.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_3:11.text: Hiking can be such a great release. Maybe finding a local trail could help a bit here too.

p9/p9_conv_3:12.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_3:12.text: I thought about that, but it's hard to find time when I'm trying to settle in and manage this job.

p9/p9_conv_3:13.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_3:13.text: That makes sense. It can be a lot to juggle at once.

p9/p9_conv_3:14.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_3:14.text: I wish I could take some time off to figure things out, but I'm worried about the rent and bills.

p9/p9_conv_3:15.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_3:15.text: Financial stress can add a lot of pressure. Have you talked to anyone at home about how you're feeling?

p9/p9_conv_3:16.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_3:16.text: Not really. I don't want to worry them more than they already are.

p9/p9_conv_3:17.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_3:17.text: It's understandable to want to protect them, but sometimes sharing can help lighten the load.

p9/p9_conv_3:18.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_3:18.text: You're right. I think I just need to find the right moment.

p9/p9_conv_3:19.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_3:19.text: Whenever you're ready, talking to someone who knows you well might bring some comfort.

p9/p9_conv_3:2.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_3:2.text: Well, it's been a tough couple of weeks since I moved for this job.

p9/p9_conv_3:20.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_3:20.text: I think it would help. I miss that connection.

p9/p9_conv_3:21.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_3:21.text: Connection is so important, especially when you're feeling down. Know that I'm here to talk anytime.

p9/p9_conv_3:22.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_3:22.text: Thanks, it means a lot. I'll try to look into making more time for myself.

p9/p9_conv_3:23.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_3:23.text: That's a good step. Small changes can lead to bigger improvements over time.

p9/p9_conv_3:24.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_3:24.text: I'll start there and see how it goes. Thanks for listening.

p9/p9_conv_3:25.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_3:25.text: Anytime, Michael. You're not alone in this. Take care of yourself.

p9/p9_conv_3:3.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_3:3.text: I remember how difficult that decision was for you. Is there something specific making it harder right now?

p9/p9_conv_3:4.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_3:4.text: Yeah, I've been feeling really isolated and now I've started having this awful back pain.

p9/p9_conv_3:5.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_3:5.text: That sounds really tough, dealing with physical pain on top of everything else.

p9/p9_conv_3:6.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_3:6.text: The job itself is stressful and I think sitting for long hours isn't helping my back.

p9/p9_conv_3:7.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_3:7.text: I can imagine. It sounds like the physical and emotional stress are piling up.

p9/p9_conv_3:8.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_3:8.text: Yeah, it's like I can't catch a break. I already miss home and now this...

p9/p9_conv_3:9.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_3:9.text: Homesickness can be really hard. Is there anything from home that comforts you?

p9/p9_conv_4:0.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_4:0.text: Hi Michael, how are you feeling these days?

p9/p9_conv_4:1.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_4:1.text: Hey, I've been better. There's been a lot on my plate recently, and it's starting to get to me.

p9/p9_conv_4:10.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_4:10.text: It makes perfect sense that you'd feel disconnected. Keeping in touch can help a bit, though. How are those conversations going?

p9/p9_conv_4:11.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_4:11.text: They're okay. My friends are supportive, but they lead different lives now. I guess that adds to my feelings of being out of place.

p9/p9_conv_4:12.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_4:12.text: It's understandable to feel disconnected when life's circumstances set a different pace for everyone. Have you thought about seeking out any community groups or activities locally?

p9/p9_conv_4:13.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_4:13.text: I've considered it, but with the strange work hours and everything, it's been difficult to commit to anything new.

p9/p9_conv_4:14.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_4:14.text: It's challenging to find the energy for new things when already feeling stretched thin. Sometimes even little steps can help. Is there anything that used to bring you joy that you could try to reconnect with?

p9/p9_conv_4:15.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_4:15.text: I used to enjoy playing guitar, but it feels like ages since I picked it up. I'm worried I won't have time, or worse, that I won't get any joy from it.

p9/p9_conv_4:16.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_4:16.text: That sounds like a nice start. Even just a few moments a week can offer some relief. Revisiting a hobby might also bring a sense of familiarity amidst the change.

p9/p9_conv_4:17.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_4:17.text: You're right. It might be worth trying again. I guess I need to find a way to work it into my schedule and see how it goes.

p9/p9_conv_4:18.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_4:18.text: I think that's a great idea. Be kind to yourself as you get back into things. It's all about small steps. You've been through a lot, and it's okay to take your time.

p9/p9_conv_4:19.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_4:19.text: Thanks. It helps to know someone understands. I'll try to take it one day at a time and see where it leads.

p9/p9_conv_4:2.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_4:2.text: I'm sorry to hear that. What's been going on?

p9/p9_conv_4:20.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_4:20.text: Absolutely. And if you ever need to talk, I’m here. Remember, you're not alone in this.

p9/p9_conv_4:21.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_4:21.text: I appreciate that. It means a lot having someone to reach out to. I'll keep you posted on how things go.

p9/p9_conv_4:3.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_4:3.text: Well, you remember that job I took a while back? It's been rough. And to add to everything, I had a falling out with a colleague I thought I could rely on.

p9/p9_conv_4:4.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_4:4.text: That sounds really tough. It's never easy when work stresses build, and there's tension with someone you hoped would be supportive. What happened between you two?

p9/p9_conv_4:5.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_4:5.text: At first, they were really supportive. But I guess things got complicated—misunderstandings, I suppose. We stopped seeing eye to eye, and now it just feels awkward and stressful.

p9/p9_conv_4:6.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_4:6.text: Misunderstandings can really strain relationships, especially those at work where you might already feel pressured. How's that been affecting you?

p9/p9_conv_4:7.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_4:7.text: It's been hard. I'm already far from home, and this just makes everything feel lonelier. I moved out here hoping things would get better, but it's been quite the opposite.

p9/p9_conv_4:8.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_4:8.text: Isolation can be incredibly tough, especially when you're in a new place. It sounds like you're dealing with a lot of significant changes. Have you been able to find any outlet or support?

p9/p9_conv_4:9.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_4:9.text: Not really. I mean, I've been trying to keep in touch with old friends back home, but it's not the same as having someone here to talk to face-to-face.

p9/p9_conv_5:0.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_5:0.text: Hey Michael, how have you been feeling lately?

p9/p9_conv_5:1.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_5:1.text: Hi, to be honest, things have been rough. I’ve been feeling a lot of anxiety lately.

p9/p9_conv_5:10.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_5:10.text: It’s tough to feel like there’s no way out. Maybe connecting with someone from home might help a little, even just for a chat?

p9/p9_conv_5:11.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_5:11.text: I’ve thought about it. I miss the familiarity of home and having people around who really know me.

p9/p9_conv_5:12.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_5:12.text: Your feelings make complete sense, especially after such a big change. Is there anything about your job or new environment that you enjoy?

p9/p9_conv_5:13.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_5:13.text: I guess there's a little bit of freedom with the gig work, but the pay isn’t stable. It makes planning anything feel impossible.

p9/p9_conv_5:14.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_5:14.text: Financial uncertainty can add a lot to your stress. It sounds like you’re juggling a lot right now. Have you thought about looking for a job closer to home?

p9/p9_conv_5:15.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_5:15.text: I have, but there aren’t many opportunities in my area. I’m not sure what to do next.

p9/p9_conv_5:16.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_5:16.text: It's understandable to feel uncertain about the future. Maybe exploring a few options, even if they seem like long shots, can open up unexpected opportunities?

p9/p9_conv_5:17.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_5:17.text: That’s a good point. I guess trying something new doesn’t hurt. I just have to find the courage to do it.

p9/p9_conv_5:18.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_5:18.text: That’s the spirit, Michael. Reaching out for help and acknowledging how you’re feeling is already a huge step forward. I’m here for you whenever you need to talk.

p9/p9_conv_5:19.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_5:19.text: Thanks. It helps knowing that I’m not alone, even if it feels that way sometimes.

p9/p9_conv_5:2.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_5:2.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you think it’s related to your new job?

p9/p9_conv_5:20.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_5:20.text: You’re definitely not alone. I’m really glad you reached out. Keep taking things one day at a time, okay?

p9/p9_conv_5:21.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_5:21.text: I will try. Thank you for your support. It means a lot.

p9/p9_conv_5:3.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_5:3.text: Yeah, I think so. Ever since I moved, it's been hard to adjust. The distance from home is tough, and my job isn’t what I expected.

p9/p9_conv_5:4.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_5:4.text: That sounds really difficult. Moving somewhere new can be incredibly isolating, especially with a work environment that isn't fulfilling.

p9/p9_conv_5:5.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_5:5.text: Exactly. I thought I'd get used to it, but loneliness is tough. Plus, after that falling out with my colleague, work feels even more stressful.

p9/p9_conv_5:6.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_5:6.text: Conflict at work can make everything feel heavier. It’s understandable why you’re feeling this way. How's your physical health holding up?

p9/p9_conv_5:7.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_5:7.text: Not great. I have back pain from being under stress constantly. It’s just another thing to worry about.

p9/p9_conv_5:8.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_5:8.text: I'm really sorry to hear that, Michael. Chronic stress can definitely take a toll on your body. Have you been able to find any ways to relieve some of the stress?

p9/p9_conv_5:9.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_5:9.text: I’ve tried a few things, like going for walks, but it hasn’t helped much. I just feel kind of stuck.

p9/p9_conv_6:0.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_6:0.text: Hey, do you have a moment to talk?

p9/p9_conv_6:1.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_6:1.text: Of course, Michael. What's on your mind?

p9/p9_conv_6:10.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_6:10.text: Yeah, exactly. I thought I had someone to lean on, but it just became another source of stress.

p9/p9_conv_6:11.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_6:11.text: Relationships can be really challenging. You've been through so much, and it’s okay to feel affected by it. Are you considering reaching out to anyone else for support?

p9/p9_conv_6:12.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_6:12.text: I haven’t yet. It’s hard for me to ask for help or even trust it’ll come through.

p9/p9_conv_6:2.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_6:2.text: I'm feeling really overwhelmed lately. My car broke down, and it's making everything so much harder.

p9/p9_conv_6:3.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_6:3.text: I'm really sorry to hear that. It sounds incredibly frustrating. How are you managing with the commute now?

p9/p9_conv_6:4.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_6:4.text: It's been tough. I'm relying on public transport, but it's not reliable out here. I spend a lot more time traveling and it's exhausting.

p9/p9_conv_6:5.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_6:5.text: I can imagine how draining that must be. It makes everything feel like such a struggle. Is there anything that’s been helping you cope?

p9/p9_conv_6:6.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_6:6.text: Not really. It's just one thing after another. I already felt isolated with the job being far from home, and now this.

p9/p9_conv_6:7.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_6:7.text: It's completely understandable to feel that way, especially when everything's piling up. Have you thought about any alternatives or getting help with the car?

p9/p9_conv_6:8.speaker: seeker
p9/p9_conv_6:8.text: I’ve thought about maybe borrowing some money to fix it, but it adds stress. I just keep thinking about our colleague, James, and how the situation with them went sour too.

p9/p9_conv_6:9.speaker: supporter
p9/p9_conv_6:9.text: I know the falling out with James was hard for you. Sometimes it feels like people let us down when we need them most.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Not really. I don't want to worry them more than they already are.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: It's been hard. I'm already far from home, and this just makes everything feel lonelier. I moved out here hoping things would get better, but it's been quite the opposite.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: yes i have faith in people very fast

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: I appreciate that. It means a lot having someone to reach out to. I'll keep you posted on how things go.

dfbf351ec626543726c7e6c907d915619d71e628.head: ME
dfbf351ec626543726c7e6c907d915619d71e628.statement: discussed feelings of isolation and doubt with supporter

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Thanks. I appreciate talking about this. I don't feel as overwhelmed knowing there's someone here to listen.

spans.speaker: seeker
